opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Mirayala Rambabu vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 6
August, 2019
 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4695 of 2019
Order:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against him, in FIR No.176 of 2019 on the file of the Tenali II Town Police Station, Guntur.
The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 420, 270, 272, 273, 188, 328 IPC and Sections 56, 57 (I) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.176 of 2019 on the file of the Tenali II Town Police Station, Guntur, for the offences under Sections 188, 420, 270, 272, 273, 188, 328 IPC and Sections 56, 57 (I) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006,
are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
